The brief facts of the case, as discernible from the DAR and documents of the petitioner namely Ajeet Kumar (hereinafter referred as petitioner/claimant/injured), are that, on 02.12.2013, the petitioner, along with his neighbour Mohan Singh @ Tinku Mahan and Pramod Kumar, was going on the motorcycle of Mohan Singh, make Pulsar, bearing registration no. DL-8SBD-3286 (hereinafter referred to as the victim's vehicle), which was driven by Mohan Singh, from his house at Rajeev Nagar, to his company, which is situated at Majri, Karala Village, Delhi and at about 10.30 am, when they reached at Karala Stadium, then the victim's vehicle was hit by one car, bearing registration no. DL-2CZ-7771 (hereinafter referred as offending vehicle), which was coming from the street of Baldev Vihar.

It was further alleged that Kapil S/o Sh. Ramesh (hereinafter referred to as the driver of the offending vehicle/Respondent no.1/R1), was driving the offending vehicle, in a rash and negligent manner and hit the victim's vehicle, with great force, as a result of which, the petitioner along with Mohan Singh @ Tinku Mahan and Pramod Kumar, fell down on the road and sustained injuries.
It was further averred that after the accident, R1 MACT No. 102/18 Page 5 of40 Ajeet vs Kapil and Ors.

Page 6 of40 came to them and when people, who gathered at the spot, asked him, to take the injured persons to the hospital, R1 refused and told them, as to whether the injured persons are his brother in law, so that he will take them to the hospital and thereafter, he went away with the offending vehicle.

It was further averred that thereafter, Mohan Singh @ Tinku Mahan,
called Mr. Rakesh Gupta, owner of his company, who came and shifted them to Baba Saheb Ambedkar Hospital, Sector-6, Rohini, Delhi (hereinafter referred to as the BSA Hospital), where the petitioner, along with Mohan Singh @ Tinku Mahan and Pramod Kumar, were medically examined,
vide MLC No. 12690/13, MLC No. 12836/13 and 12688/13 respectively and as per the said MLCs,
Pramod Kumar and Ajit have sustained simple injuries and Mohan Singh @ Tinku Mahan has sustained grievous injuries.
It was further averred that Pramod Kumar and Ajit were discharged on the same day, from BSA Hospital but, Mohan Singh @ Tinku, remains admitted for his treatment.

3. As per DAR, at the time of accident, the offending vehicle was driven by R1, who was also its registered owner and the same was insured with United India Insurance Company Ltd (hereinafter referred to as the insurance company/R3), vide insurance policy No. 041782/31/13/02/0012011,
